name: Libraries & Museums Finance Internships
focus: Finance, accounting, endowment/investment-office, development, and treasury internships at libraries, museums, archives, and cultural institutions (100+ swept) — part-time and virtual roles compatible with the 2026-27 school year flagged; pay (incl. unpaid/stipend) noted per role
competitiveness_note: Cultural-sector finance internships are niche: fewer applicants than Wall Street pipelines, but few open seats and many are unpaid or stipend-based. Museums with real endowment/investment offices (Getty, Met, Smithsonian) are the most competitive.

internships.notes: Searched LOC's 80+ program portfolio (LOCI, Junior Fellows, SIP) and Office of the CFO; no finance/accounting/budget-specific placement track surfaced in any listing or project catalog. LOCI itself is full-time (40 hrs/wk), not part-time-compatible.

Duties include logging financial systems for audit/close-out reporting and reviewing invoicing records. Unpaid (may be done for academic credit). Application window for Fall 2026 closed July 10, 2026. NARA's Spring 2027 VIP cycle opens for applications Nov 2, 2026 - re-apply then for a school-year-compatible slot; historically this Business/Accounting/Budget Analysis track recurs each term at College Park and other NARA facilities.

Summer 2026 cohort (June 8-Aug 14, 2026) is already in progress as of today; application window closed. Paid, found via Smithsonian OFI/SOLAA federal-adjacent internship pipeline (Program ID 2235). Watch for Fall/Spring reposting.
